title: •Red Leader
caption: •Red Leader (V)
game_text: {pilot:2}. While piloting at Dantooine system, when opponent deploys a character to a related site, they choose: opponent must lose 1 Force. OR that character may not battle or move this turn.
lore: X-wing pilot Garven Dreis. Led Red Squadron at the Battle of Yavin, and fired an unsuccessful shot at the Death Star thermal exhaust port. Served at Dantooine Rebel base.
copyright: TM & © 1995 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1995 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Stats POWER 2 / ABILITY 2; third stat box printed EMPTY (blank silver box, no label) — stored as two stats like vs13/07. Deploy 2 / forfeit 5. Yellow pilot icon + '2.' → {pilot:2} (stub expands). Icon column: pilot (helmet on yellow), warrior (blue, blaster). Rebel (Rebel disc on the printed card). Default wiki page is Glossary errata; printed face = 'Red Leader (Original)' (Premiere Limited, black border). The 347 px Premiere-L-redleader.gif is the errata face (E; 'anything he pilots…') — used as art.src (square-on scan, same art); the 367×506 decipher-archive file is a PHOTO of the printed card on a white page — downloaded for lore/copyright only, NOT art. Lore matches the wiki and the scans; 'leader' is not a word in this lore. Copyright 1995 (Premiere). Modern: Virtual Block 1 only (VB1 -pre, 350 px).
